thread:
alex_oncall: paging: GPU autoscaler hit max_nodes for us-west-2 pool, queue length climbing past 18k, heavy throttles reported by gateway. Investigating.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2027-0456 — autoscale ceiling reached in us-west-2. Severity: P1. Pager duty: alex_oncall.
maya_sre: seeing steady enqueues since 09:42 UTC, token-generation requests are 5xxing with 429s upstream. Grafana: gpu-node-count=12 (max), pending-pods=420, avg-queue-age=22s.
alex_oncall: confirmed. Can we route new requests to eu-west while we remediate? Any cross-region fallback enabled?
juan_runtime: eu-west has capacity but model variants differ. We can route non-low-latency customers, but prod traffic is mostly pinned to us-west due to data locality.
rachel_support: Pager reports from two customers (Acme, Skylift) with elevated errors. Acme on Dedicated; Skylift on Hosted. Need impact statements for both.
lee_infra: autoscaler policy shows "max_nodes: 12" from the reserved pool config. There's also a hard quota at cloud provider for this project: 12 GPUs. We need a manual cap raise or quota request.
maya_sre: immediate mitigations: a) reduce max-pods-per-node to open up headroom? b) drain non-critical jobs? c) enable fallback to CPU-based smaller model? Thoughts?
juan_runtime: (a) won't help if nodes already at kube-sched limits. (b) we can cordon some lower-priority workloads; draining still needs free nodes to move pods. (c) we have a quantized variant (llama-q8) that uses half the GPU memory — can batch to fit more pods per node, should reduce queue.\alex_oncall: do (c) now, and start a manual node request. Who has quota uplift rights?
lee_infra: I'll open support ticket with cloud provider for quota bump to 18 nodes — but that's 30-45m. For immediate, I can request a temporary manual node add if we have spare account capacity in another project. Asking infra leads.
\rachel_support: Notifying Acme: "We're aware of elevated errors from us-west; we're activating mitigations and will provide ETA for restoration." Keeping them in loop.
maya_sre: executing rollback to quantized variant for non-enterprise customers. Command: ```kubectl set image deploy/gpu-infer gpu-infer=redwood/llama-q8:20270315 --namespace=production```
juan_runtime: also toggling routing rule for Skylift to route to eu-west fallback: ```rewriter route set --service skylift --region eu-west --grace 60s```
alex_oncall: logs show many pending pods failing with OOM when trying to pre-warm KV cache. Example error: "OOMKilled: attempted allocate 8.3GiB". Quantized variant avoids that.
maya_sre: after image change, pending pods dropped from 420 -> 190. Queue length stabilized but still high. Latency improved for non-enterprise flows.
lee_infra: infra lead approved a temporary manual node attach from our staging project — +3 GPUs now provisioning (ETA ~6m). Raising cloud quota ticket as well.
incident-bot: Cloud ticket CLOUD-REQ-789 opened for quota increase to 18 GPUs in us-west-2.
juan_runtime: after +3 nodes, node_count=15. Autoscaler still capped at 12 config value though — because HPA config prevents dynamic increase beyond pool max. We should bump pool config to 18 to let autoscaler use nodes.
alex_oncall: who can edit pool max? Need approver for manual cap change (security review).
lee_infra: I can change the pool config but need signoff from product for cost impact > 20%. rachel_support: product notified, product ok with temporary bump for customer availability.
maya_sre: performing manual update to autoscale config: ```kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_nodes":"18"}}'```
juan_runtime: autoscaler saw config change and started scaling to 18. New pods scheduling. Monitoring CPU/GPU utilization.
maya_sre: queue length now down to 40% of peak. 5xx and 429s dropping. Median latency for generation fell from 3.6s -> 1.8s.
rachel_support: informing Acme and Skylift: "We've increased capacity and enabled fallback model for some traffic. Errors markedly reduced. Monitoring for full recovery."
alex_oncall: post-mortem notes we need: clearer runbook for manual cap bump, documented approvers, and automated fallback to quantized model when OOM spikes. Also check kube-pod limits and pod eviction thresholds.
juan_runtime: follow-ups: (1) add automated policy to roll to q-variants under OOM risk, (2) add circuit-breaker to route to another region when queue_age > 15s, (3) request permanent quota increase to 24 for peak events.
lee_infra: cloud quota increase approved to 24 GPUs after phone call, ticket updated. Will coordinate scheduled reservation for Dedicated customers.
maya_sre: final metrics stable. I'll close the incident once customer confirmations arrive.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2027-0456 status changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring.
alex_oncall: handoff to night oncall @maya_sre in 15m. Any unfinished tasks?
\maya_sre: will monitor autoscaler, finish postmortem doc, and follow up with infra on permanent quota.
rachel_support: I'll confirm with Acme/Skylift and escalate refunds if they request.
juan_runtime: tagging infra and devex for runbook updates.
lee_infra: logging cost impact estimate: provisional +3 nodes for 1h, +manual bump to 18 for 45m, will provide numbers to finance.
alex_oncall: thanks team. Closing console for change window. :thumbsup:
